name: Fujian Mahjong
description: Fujian Mahjong refers to regional Mahjong play in China's Fujian province with local scoring conventions layered on top of standard draw-discard meld play. Games typically follow the familiar wall draw and discard-claim rhythm while using table profiles for what qualifies as a winning hand and how value is computed.

overview.description: Fujian Mahjong refers to regional Mahjong play in China's Fujian province with local scoring conventions layered on top of standard draw-discard meld play. Games typically follow the familiar wall draw and discard-claim rhythm while using table profiles for what qualifies as a winning hand and how value is computed.

history.origins: Fujian Mahjong developed from Chinese Mahjong traditions as local table rules spread through home and community play in Fujian.
timeline: 20th century: regional house rules become stable through repeated social play.
Modern era: online implementations document common Fujian profiles and terminology.
history.cultural: It is widely played as a social table game in Fujian communities and diaspora groups.
history.evolution: While hand structure remains consistent with Mahjong, Fujian tables differ in acceptable wins, scoring patterns, and emphasis on speed versus value.

setup.deck: Standard Mahjong set with suited tiles, honor tiles, and bonus tiles according to table profile.
setup.dealing: Each player receives 13 tiles; dealer receives 14 and discards first.

rules.objective: Complete a legal winning hand and satisfy the active Fujian scoring profile.
rules.gameplay: Players take turns drawing one tile and discarding one tile. Discards can be claimed for legal melds subject to claim priority rules. A hand wins on self-draw or discard claim when it meets the hand structure and any profile-specific validity requirements.
keyRules: Draw then discard is the default turn loop.
Claims interrupt turn order only when a legal meld is formed.
Winning requires a complete hand under the chosen Fujian profile.

strategy.basic: Build efficient shapes and avoid discarding tiles that complete obvious opponent waits.
strategy.intermediate: Track suit distribution and honor visibility to estimate remaining outs and danger tiles.
strategy.advanced: Switch between fast completion and higher-value shaping based on wall depth and opponent pressure.
tips: Preserve flexible tiles early to keep multiple routes open.
Defend when opponents reveal strong, coherent meld direction.

synthesis.shortDescription: Fujian Mahjong is a family of Fujian regional Mahjong profiles using standard draw-discard meld play with local scoring conventions.
